bool rmt_prov_client_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf pcb)

Register remote provision client.

Parameters:

  • pcb -- [in] Client data callback function.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration success.

  • false -- Registration failed. Verify parameters.

Returns:

Registration status.
